title: 先進封裝V2：架構至RDL的分支工藝教學
titleEn: Advanced Packaging V2: Branched Operations from Architecture to RDL
dataAvailability: 本教材提供原創操作說明及檢核題，未附260份實測數據或工序專用數值模擬器。量測任務使用學徒自行提供、由來源合法取得或明示假設的教學資料。
dataAvailabilityEn: This curriculum supplies authored operation descriptions and checks, not 260 measured datasets or operation-specific simulators. Measurement tasks use learner-supplied, lawfully sourced or explicitly hypothetical teaching data.
scope: 260項可檢核的教學操作，涵蓋架構與打線、覆晶、扇出三條分支；不是一條必須依序執行的260站量產SOP。未提供專有配方、允收數值或設備操作授權。
scopeEn: 260 assessable educational operations spanning architecture and wirebond, flipchip and fan-out branches; not a single 260-station production SOP. No proprietary recipes, universal acceptance numbers or equipment authorization are supplied.
navigationNote: sequence是課程索引；真實製程相依以prerequisiteIds和route為準。m08的pk-202至pk-208需在m09的pk-234後執行。覆晶晶圓凸塊m07在選定薄化切割之前。
navigationNoteEn: sequence is a curriculum index; manufacturing dependencies follow prerequisiteIds and route. m08 steps pk-202 through pk-208 follow m09 step pk-234. Wafer bumping m07 precedes selected thinning and singulation.

stages.title: 封裝架構、DFM與材料選擇
stages.titleEn: Package architecture, DFM and material selection
stages.description: 以26項獨立教學操作檢查封裝架構、DFM與材料選擇的材料、介面、量測和異常判讀。使用自行建立的示意模型，或您提供／由來源合法取得的量測資料；本課程未附逐工序實測表。門檻須明示為教學假設或來自合格材料文件。
stages.descriptionEn: Twenty-six distinct educational operations review materials, interfaces, metrology and diagnosis for package architecture, dfm and material selection. Use schematic models you create, or measurement data you supply or lawfully obtain from sources. No operation-specific measured tables are bundled. State limits as teaching assumptions or derive them from qualified material documents.
stages.route: 共用架構規劃；選定分支後才建立製程旅行單。
stages.routeEn: Shared architecture planning; select a branch before building a traveler.
